hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — Q, 4. Both players called a raise before the cards were dealt.
Flop — 10, Queen, King. You bet. Your opponent raised.
Turn — Jack. Your opponent led out with a bet. You called.
River — Ace. Your opponent fired again — half the pot.

wrongReasons: Q J is close, but the river lead is the tell. The correct hand picked up more on the river than Q J would have.
8 5 is close, but the river lead is the tell. The correct hand picked up more on the river than 8 5 would have.
8 4 is close, but the river lead is the tell. The correct hand picked up more on the river than 8 4 would have.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 4 6

Your opponent flopped a straight and immediately raised to build the pot. They led every remaining street — consistent value betting across all streets is a strong signal of a made hand.
